title: Sumsets regularity versus Castelnuovo-Mumford regularity for monomial curves
summary: Let $A=\{0=a_0<a_1<\dots<a_{k-1}=d\}$ be integers with greatest common divisor $1$, let $C_A$ be the projective monomial curve they define, and let $\mathrm{reg}(A)$ be the Castelnuovo-Mumford regularity of its coordinate ring. Gimenez and González-Sánchez proved $\mathrm{reg}(A)\leσ(A)+1$ for the sumsets regularity $σ(A)$; the reverse inequality $σ(A)\le\mathrm{reg}(A)$ was proposed as an open conjecture in a 2024 talk.
